review_notes: I read the whole file. I did not open Mathlib sources or the Basic file, so this verdict rests on the file text and my knowledge of Mathlib. The only new definition is `sectorCurve`. It is a specific piecewise model curve (ray, arc, ray) on [0,3]. It is not a general concept that Mathlib already provides under another name. I saw no Mathlib structure for paths, circle maps or principal values that it replaces. `cauchyPrincipalValue'` and `CauchyPrincipalValueExists'` come from the library's own Basic file, not from this file. The private `intervalIntegrable_union_adjacent` is a theorem-level overlap with Mathlib's interval-integrability lemmas such as `IntervalIntegrable.trans`. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not report it. The repeated `let F` cutoff expressions are a proof-structure matter, not a competing concept. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
